boundaryGate.question: After Alembic main commit 42ab1613692fda5f7efb20de9d00cd35ebde796a, does the real BiliDili no-preclean P10 rerun avoid stale ProjectContext workflow sessions and open deep_mining_rounds after public rescan cancellation/completion, then produce non-empty host measured coverage and an empty normalized host-vs-in-process parity diff?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace only, using the configured Alembic/Test route and existing DeepSeek generation plus local Qwen/Ollama embeddings. This card validates the P10 post-repair real scenario; it does not authorize source edits or final P10/G4/G6 acceptance.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted Alembic commit 42ab161 as the narrow source repair after reviewing target result, source diff, focused tests, build:check, lint:repo-boundary, and diff whitespace.

Prior Test evidence for p10-bilidili-post-session-cleanup-rerun showed public rescan cancellation left an active ProjectContext workflow session and an open deep_mining_rounds row, so a real rerun is required.
BiliDili data-root SQLite corruption had already been handled before this chain; this rerun must recheck integrity as evidence instead of assuming it.
No P10 parity, G4 coverage, G6 removal, or demand completion has been accepted by the controller.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace and BiliDili data root only; do not use a sandbox copy.
Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Ollama for embeddings.
Run the no-preclean route unless a first-order blocker proves restart/reset is unavoidable; if any reset/rebuild is used, record the exact public route and R-2 root/data-root proof.
Before destructive or rebuild operations, prove the R-2 triple: BiliDili project root, BiliDili data root, and Alembic state root.
Use Alembic main HEAD 42ab161 or later containing the accepted repair; record all source pins.
successMeans: SQLite integrity is clean before the rerun and at final snapshot.
Public rescan cancellation/completion no longer leaves active ProjectContext workflow sessions for BiliDili.
No open deep_mining_rounds row remains for the cancelled/completed rescan job; closed rows include diagnostic evidence rather than manual DB mutation.
Host route produces a usable coverageLedgerSeed and target-scoped measured coverage with measuredRows greater than 0, not merely an empty grade surface.
Normalized host-vs-in-process/moduleScope parity diff is empty and is not a 0-vs-0 or empty-coverage pass.
All raw JSON/log/DB/session/parity artifacts are written under Test/tmp/p10-bilidili-post-rescan-cancellation-cleanup-rerun-t1/ and summarized in a TargetResultEnvelope.
failureMeans: Any active BiliDili ProjectContext workflow session or open deep_mining_rounds row remains after public cancel/completion.
Coverage ledger output is empty, root/aggregate-scoped only, or lacks target-scoped measured coverage.
Parity cannot run, differs after normalization, or only passes because both sides are empty.
The route touches a non-BiliDili root/data root, changes providers, or performs manual database cleanup as validation.
SQLite corruption recurs or blocks the no-preclean route.
cannotConclude: Alembic source repair is complete beyond commit 42ab161's narrow cancellation cleanup acceptance.
P10 is complete without controller review of this Test result.
G4 coverage gate, G6 twin/shim removal, or final demand completion is satisfied.
Empty parity, empty coverage, or a skipped host route is acceptable.
Any behavior on non-BiliDili roots or changed provider configuration.
stopConditions: R-2 root/data-root/state-root identity cannot be proven before destructive or rebuild work.
Provider configuration differs from DeepSeek generation plus local Qwen/Ollama embeddings.
The existing route would require source edits in Test, Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, or BiliDili; stop and backfill the exact owner and first blocker.
SQLite integrity failure blocks trustworthy evidence collection.
The verifier would need manual DB/session/coverage mutation to pass.

evidenceRequired: Source pins: Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, Test, and BiliDili commit hashes.
No-preclean proof and any public reset/rebuild/cancel route proof if used.
SQLite integrity output before and after the rerun.
Session and deep_mining_rounds snapshots before cold-start/rescan, after rescan cancel/completion, and final.
Host route outputs including coverageLedgerSeed and measured coverage row counts.
Normalized host-vs-in-process parity artifact proving diff is empty and coverage is non-empty.
TargetResultEnvelope summary with exact blocker if blocked.
allowedOperations: Read controller state root, Test AGENTS, Test scripts, prior evidence, logs, JSON artifacts, and BiliDili SQLite metadata needed for verification.
Run existing Test real-scenario verification commands for BiliDili and capture outputs under Test/tmp/p10-bilidili-post-rescan-cancellation-cleanup-rerun-t1/.
Query SQLite read-only for integrity, active sessions, deep_mining_rounds, coverage ledger, and parity evidence.
Use public Alembic bootstrap/rescan/cancel routes as the scenario requires, with R-2 proof and no manual state edits.
forbiddenOperations: Edit source code in any repository.
Change provider configuration, model selection, ports, version pins, freeze strings, schema names, or vendor pointers.
Manually clean, update, or delete BiliDili DB rows, session state, or coverage rows to make the test pass.
Use a sandbox copy, non-BiliDili project root, non-BiliDili data root, or default preclean route as the primary evidence.
Accept 0-vs-0 parity, empty measured coverage, or aggregate/root module ids as success.
